#409 · Pages/Auth.razor · declaration 1

#408 · Shared/TicketRelations.razor · declaration 1

Changed: scoped compact typography, bounded body scrolling, fixed headers and calm named actions/tabs where present. Native data paging is retained or added for growing lists; fixed editor/detail collections retain their original semantics.

#403 · Shared/TicketTable.razor · declaration 1

Changed: scoped compact typography, bounded body scrolling, fixed headers and calm named actions/tabs where present. Native data paging is retained or added for growing lists; fixed editor/detail collections retain their original semantics.

#408 · Pages/Assets/AssetList.razor · declaration 1

Changed: scoped compact typography, bounded body scrolling, fixed headers and calm named actions/tabs where present. Native data paging is retained or added for growing lists; fixed editor/detail collections retain their original semantics.

#407 · Pages/Ops/WorkflowOpsDashboard.razor · declaration 2

Changed: scoped compact typography, bounded body scrolling, fixed headers and calm named actions/tabs where present. Native data paging is retained or added for growing lists; fixed editor/detail collections retain their original semantics.

#402 · Pages/SelfService/MyRequestDetail.razor · declaration 1

Changed: scoped compact typography, bounded body scrolling, fixed headers and calm named actions/tabs where present. Native data paging is retained or added for growing lists; fixed editor/detail collections retain their original semantics.

#408 · Pages/Admin/Requests/RequestFormBuilder.razor · declaration 1

Changed: scoped compact typography, bounded body scrolling, fixed headers and calm named actions/tabs where present. Native data paging is retained or added for growing lists; fixed editor/detail collections retain their original semantics.

#408 · Pages/Admin/Requests/RequestFormBuilder.razor · declaration 3

Changed: scoped compact typography, bounded body scrolling, fixed headers and calm named actions/tabs where present. Native data paging is retained or added for growing lists; fixed editor/detail collections retain their original semantics.

#408 · Pages/Admin/Resources/DatasetSchemaDesigner.razor · declaration 1

Changed: scoped compact typography, bounded body scrolling, fixed headers and calm named actions/tabs where present. Native data paging is retained or added for growing lists; fixed editor/detail collections retain their original semantics.

#407 · Pages/Admin/SupportNotifications/OrganizationSupportCoveragePanel.razor · declaration 1

Changed: scoped compact typography, bounded body scrolling, fixed headers and calm named actions/tabs where present. Native data paging is retained or added for growing lists; fixed editor/detail collections retain their original semantics.

#406 · Pages/Admin/User/TenantAdministration.razor · declaration 1

Changed: scoped compact typography, bounded body scrolling, fixed headers and calm named actions/tabs where present. Native data paging is retained or added for growing lists; fixed editor/detail collections retain their original semantics.

#409 · Pages/Admin/User/UserManagement.razor · declaration 1

Changed: scoped compact typography, bounded body scrolling, fixed headers and calm named actions/tabs where present. Native data paging is retained or added for growing lists; fixed editor/detail collections retain their original semantics.
